Eleven assets remain available only on the editable asset board because their matching initial native content slots are absent. Three of those are product records outside the five existing native product rows. Unknown/workspace initials and AI empty states are retained.
Native Carousel specimens retain their controlled16:10 crop; current source collection images have3:2 metadata. This scoped integration does not claim pixel-perfect full-screen parity.
